name: Argolebias guarani

detail_en: It inhabits seasonal pools in the middle Paraná basin. Males have small iridescent blue-green spots. When the pools dry, adults die and eggs remain buried until the water returns; the species was described in 2023.
range_en: Misiones, Argentina · middle Paraná basin

range_en: Salta, Argentina · semi-arid Chaco

short_en: A small, light-and-dark-banded killifish that stays near the surface.
detail_en: It is recorded in shallow, marshy waters in Sierra Leone and Monrovia. It may lay eggs in mops and floating plants; the eggs and fry are very small. Pseudepiplatys annulatus is another name used in the hobby.
range_en: Guinea · Liberia · Sierra Leone

range: Tanzania
